content:
samir: Heads up — noticed quota dashboard showing ~60% less tokens for some streaming sessions that do tool calls + reconnects. Account flagged: acct_42. Anyone seen this?

anya: Yep, saw it on the canary earlier. My hunch: when a stream reconnects and a toolcall gets truncated we only record the final 'commit' event, and in the reconnect path that commit sometimes never arrives. Console only surface the confirmed commits so it underreports.

lee: Can you paste a trace sample?

samir: Sure — pasted quick seq from the router logs (redacted session ids):
```
EVENT: STREAM_START session=abc123
EVENT: STREAM_CHUNK session=abc123 tokens=480
EVENT: STREAM_CHUNK session=abc123 tokens=720
EVENT: TOOL_CALL_START id=t1 session=abc123
EVENT: TOOL_CALL_TRUNCATED id=t1 reason=client_timeout tokens_charged=0
EVENT: STREAM_RECONNECT session=abc123
EVENT: STREAM_CHUNK session=abc123 tokens=300
# missing STREAM_FINALIZE/COMMIT event here
```
In the metrics pipeline we only see the initial chunks (sampled) and then the reconnect chunk, but no final commit. UI shows ~1.5k tokens instead of the ~3k that the full session actually used.

kai: That matches a theory we had during the routing retry work — router emits a commit on EOF, but in reconnect/fallback we sometimes short-circuit and never emit commit. Billing ingests only commit events (explicit finalize) so provisional tallies are ignored. We debated emitting provisional credits earlier but worried about double-charging.

anya: Plus our console telemetry is aggressively sampled for high-volume paths (we sample chunk events at 1%). Many of these short-lived, bursty sessions fall outside samples or get dropped at the aggregator during spikes. So it's a two-fold problem: missing commit + sampling sparsity.

samir: Proposal: add an idempotent "finalize_session" RPC from serving runtime to billing/ledger with payload {session_id, final_token_count, seq_token_hash}. On reconnect path the runtime can call finalize again; billing dedupes by session_id+seq_hash. That gives an authoritative final number. Also surface a provisional vs confirmed column in the console so users can see both.

lee: Implementation concerns: if finalize RPC retries, we must ensure dedupe semantics are rock-solid. Also DB write amplification — finalizing on every reconnect would cause more writes. We should design to only finalize once per session (but let duplicates be safe). Use write-if-not-exists with idempotency token.

kai: Alternative short-term: push incremental "chunk_ack" lightweight writes for each chunk to ledger (very small payload) so dashboard can show near-realtime tally without waiting for finalize. That reduces the risk of undercounting when commit is lost, but increases write QPS. Tradeoffs: accuracy vs ingestion cost.

anya: Short-term UI mitigation: show "provisional (estimated)" column in the console for streaming sessions, and add a workspace toggle to include provisional in quota calculations for debugging accounts. That helps support teams quickly see if they're being underbilled/overbilled.

samir: Filed ISSUE-2048 with the finalize RPC design + dedupe sketch and a canary plan. I'll put an RFC in the doc and prototype tonight. @deploy-bot can we schedule a small canary for the finalize RPC + idempotency test in canary cluster?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 23:00 UTC — rolling to canary-1 with traffic=1%. Will post rollout logs in #eng-platform-canary. :white_check_mark:

samir: Thanks — I'll add dashboard mockups for provisional/confirmed columns and update support playbook.

lee: FYI add a metric for "missing_finalize_count" in the router so we can trigger alerts when finalize rate falls below chunk rate. That will help detect regressions.

kai: Agreed. Also run a short A/B where we enable chunk_ack writes for 1% of traffic to measure write cost and accuracy improvement.

anya: Cool — assigning follow-ups in the ISSUE. Closing out for now, will follow up after canary. :arrow_forward:
